title: Nitrogen family chemistry
basic_overview: N₂ has strong triple bonding; heavier pnictogens show wider coordination and oxidation-state chemistry.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Compare N₂ multiple bonding with P expanded coordination.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Compare size. 2. Assess π overlap. 3. Compare hydrides. 4. Track oxides/oxoacids.
extra_info_content.factors: NH₃ pyramidal; PCl₅ can be trigonal bipyramidal.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
